finding: These uploads are ORFD PyTorch data-loader/source files plus compiled Python cache files; they are not the ORFD image/mask dataset.

legacy_loader_behavior.gt_rule: gt_image/<stem>_fillcolor.png; positive label where source blue channel > 200
legacy_loader_behavior.legacy_resize: RGB resized to configurable use_size; mask resized to 1/4 dimensions

component_2_decision.reason: Component 2 is intended to work from ordinary smartphone RGB imagery, so ORFD is used as an auxiliary RGB traversability/freespace dataset.

pyc_policy: Do not copy or commit .pyc files. They are Python 3.6 bytecode caches and are not source data.
